note: The fixed vocabulary of templates-relation/, mined from 3 of its 3 templates by enums.mjs. Kept in templates-enum/, never inside templates-relation/ itself, so nothing that scans templates-relation/ for its own templates ever trips over this file. A field with more than 100 distinct values, or one that is close to a different value in every file, is not here — it is data, not an enum. Edit the source templates and re-run enums.mjs to update this.
